gap: Fatality events without a final report
evidence: 61 of 665 events have no published final report in the source snapshot (28 are from 2025-2026); their dossiers contain only preliminary information and the alert
impact: High for root-cause questions on recent events; keep them out of gold root-cause items
recommendation: Re-collect after MSHA publishes more final reports

evidence: 10 events have only metadata (no description) and were not turned into PDFs: 2009/fatality-17-march-19-2009-0, 2009/fatality-14-august-27-2009, 2010/fatality-3-march-22-2010, 2012/fatality-15-october-10-2012, 2013/fatality-20-december-6-2013, 2018/fatality-8-august-8-2018, 2022/september-9-2022-fatatlity, 2025/october-16-2025-fatalty, 2026/october-22-2026-fatality, 2026/october-23-2026-fatality
recommendation: Check the MSHA site for later updates

gap: Scanned PDFs without a text layer (OCR needed)
evidence: 68 source PDFs have no text layer: 63 belong to events whose HTML final report exists (content probably covered), the rest have no text alternative. Quecreek has 25 of 133 pages without text; UBB appendices B, H, L, P, Z are scans
recommendation: Install Tesseract/OCRmyPDF and run OCR on the listed files (see excluded_files.csv, reason 'no text layer')

evidence: 1,864 files (1995-2007 reports, alerts and year indexes) were left out: different format, no consistent root-cause sections, many name victims
impact: Medium for breadth of similar-incident search
recommendation: Process with the same pipeline after adding a stronger redaction (named-entity) step

evidence: The deceased miner's name and staff names introduced with a job title are replaced; co-workers or witnesses named without a title can remain. 0 detected victim-name leaks in 655 dossiers
impact: High before any public release or demo
recommendation: Add a named-entity redaction pass (for example spaCy or Presidio) during chunking; keep the original text out of logs and traces

gap: Sketches, photographs and maps are not included
evidence: Report appendices of maps/sketches/photos are images (and may be third-party); they were dropped, so statements such as 'see Appendix C' point to content that is not available
recommendation: If needed, add image captions manually or use the original PDFs under the source licence rules

gap: Program Policy Manual is not the latest
evidence: Volume III in the dataset is the April 2006 release and Volume V June 2015; MSHA's site says Volume III was updated 26 Apr 2024

gap: Law before 2017 and for some parts
evidence: Exact-date snapshots exist only for Parts 50, 56, 57, 75, 77 from 2017; earlier years only as July-1 annual editions (2008-2025); no 2026 annual edition; Parts 46/47/48/62 have no exact-date snapshots
impact: Medium for 'law at incident date' questions
recommendation: State 'version unverified' where no edition matches; refresh when 2026 edition is published

gap: Federal Register proposed rules have no full text
evidence: 227 proposed rules are in the index (title, abstract, CFR references) but only final rules have PDFs
recommendation: Fetch PDFs for specific proposed rules if needed

gap: Upper Big Branch main report body
evidence: The dataset holds the 40-page final-report summary, the executive summary and appendices but not the full chapter-by-chapter report body
recommendation: Obtain the full report from MSHA

evidence: NIOSH mining charts are interactive (no downloadable data) and FMSHRC decisions were blocked when collected; neither is in the dataset
impact: Low to medium (contested citations, statistics cross-checks)
recommendation: Add if the project needs penalty-contest or statistics context

evidence: 15 further MSHA data sets (health samples, production, penalties, ownership) were not converted; one (107(a) orders) was kept; DustData-1986-2016.zip was advertised by MSHA but returned HTTP 404 and was never collected
recommendation: Convert on demand; they remain in the source folder
